parameter_name: Total notices in prepared corpus
computation_method: row count after dedup
caveat: Full corpus, all sectors, all notice types, not scope-filtered.

parameter_name: First/last observed date and notice count per calendar year
computation_method: groupby year, min/max/count of publication_date
caveat: 2015 and 2026 are PARTIAL years (extraction-window boundaries), not full calendar years; every other by-year table/chart in this notebook flags them the same way and they must not be compared 1:1 against FULL years.

parameter_name: Notice share by department (multi-valued, exploded)
computation_method: split on ';', explode, value_counts
caveat: code_departement can list several departments per notice; shares sum to >1.

parameter_name: Notice type composition by year
computation_method: groupby crosstab
caveat: notice_type_normalized collapses rare types to OTHER; 2015 and 2026 are PARTIAL years (see calib_year_completeness_status.csv), not full-year counts.

parameter_name: Non-null rate, all 94 columns
computation_method: df.notna().mean()
caveat: Includes both raw and derived columns; see §16b calib_data_lineage.csv for which fields are RAW vs CLEANED vs DERIVED vs IMPUTED.

parameter_name: Completeness of key fields by year
computation_method: groupby year, notna mean
caveat: Trend, not a validated forecast; 2015 and 2026 are PARTIAL years.

parameter_name: LEGACY vs EFORMS field completeness delta
computation_method: groupby schema_family, notna mean, difference
caveat: schema_family is detected heuristically from the raw donnees payload (src/utils/boamp_schema.py); not a declared field. The trailing quarters of 2026 are within the PARTIAL year and should not be read as a completed-year trend.

parameter_name: Gini coefficient, notices per buyer_key
computation_method: Lorenz curve / Gini from groupby(buyer_key).size()
caveat: buyer_key is BOAMP-native identity (SIRET/SIREN/name fallback); NAME_FALLBACK buyers aggregate multiple real entities under one key, inflating apparent concentration.

parameter_name: buyer_identifier_source distribution
computation_method: value_counts(normalize=True)
caveat: RAW_SIRET_FIELD/RAW_SIREN_FIELD/DERIVED_FROM_SIRET/NONE; format+Luhn checksum validated.

parameter_name: Share of normalized buyer names mapping to >1 buyer_key
computation_method: groupby normalized name; count distinct SIRETs/SIRENs/departments/buyer_keys and classify same-SIREN/different-SIRET, different-SIREN, department consistency
caveat: A data-quality measure of BOAMP-native identity ambiguity used to calibrate false buyer merging risk; generic institutional names are flagged separately because common nouns can represent many legal buyers.

parameter_name: Normalized names per reliable SIRET identity
stratification: by SIRET identity and activity level
computation_method: groupby SIRET; count raw/normalized names, active years, notices, earliest/latest forms and name-pair similarities
caveat: SIRET is the establishment-level identity; variation here estimates false splitting risk among the most specific reliable BOAMP-native buyer identifiers.

parameter_name: Normalized names per reliable SIREN identity
stratification: by SIREN identity and activity level
computation_method: groupby SIREN; count raw/normalized names, active years, notices, earliest/latest forms and name-pair similarities
caveat: SIREN is the legal-unit identity; it can legitimately aggregate several establishments or service renderings, so variation is not automatically an error.

parameter_name: Likely buyer-name transformation labels
computation_method: heuristic pairwise classification: punctuation/accent, legal suffix, abbreviation, acronym, location/service tokens, establishment/legal-unit, token reorder, historical change
caveat: Transformation labels are heuristic and can overlap; use them as generator corruption modes, not verified legal-name-change annotations.

parameter_name: eForms CPV parser discontinuity and recovery
stratification: raw source vs flattened vs cleaned prepared; by schema/year/eForms notice type
computation_method: notebook §8 recreates old path-containing-'cpv' parser, compares with current extractor, and validates against prepared cpv_clean
caveat: The old parser missed eForms UBL commodity-classification paths; after correction no eForms CPV is classified as genuinely absent in the current raw corpus. Downstream CPV-dependent linkage outputs still need regeneration.

parameter_name: CPV code missing rate
stratification: marginal + by year/schema/notice type/department/buyer activity/identifier source
computation_method: src/boamp/data/prepare.py cpv cleaning after eForms ItemClassificationCode recovery; mean of boolean flags
caveat: cpv_clean requires exact 8-digit format. Multiple CPV candidates are retained in the flattened candidate list but prepared cpv_clean uses the first valid token. 2015 and 2026 rows in the by-year breakdown are PARTIAL years.

parameter_name: Duration field present, full corpus
computation_method: notna mean, full corpus (not scope-filtered)
caveat: Distinct from the pipeline's 82.7%-imputed figure, which is computed only over the APPEL_OFFRE & digital-scope eligible-source subset, not the full corpus. 2015 and 2026 rows in the by-year breakdown are PARTIAL years.

parameter_name: Exact-duplicate objet_clean rate
computation_method: duplicated(keep=False).mean()
caveat: Exact-string duplication only; near-duplicate detection via fuzzy/semantic similarity would find a higher rate (no such detector is run in this notebook). This is a lower bound on text-based candidate ambiguity, not an estimate of the true near-duplicate rate.

parameter_name: Provisional notice-family size distribution
computation_method: graph components from explicit references, award links, bounded exact-text edges, and bounded high-similarity edges
caveat: Provisional lifecycle grouping only: designed to represent one procurement episode producing one or several observed notices, not later cycles for a similar need.

parameter_name: Lifecycle transition counts within provisional notice families
stratification: by source role, target role, edge type
computation_method: edge table grouped by lifecycle role and edge evidence
caveat: Role labels are derived from BOAMP notice status/category fields and collapse rare follow-up forms into FOLLOW_UP.

parameter_name: Call-to-award delay distribution in provisional notice families
stratification: award notices with an observed call in the same provisional family
computation_method: award publication date minus earliest CALL publication date in the same provisional family
caveat: Delays use first observed call in the corpus, so missing historical calls can make some award-linked families look incomplete; negative or >24-month delays are flagged, not dropped.

parameter_name: Text similarity and CPV agreement within provisional notice families
stratification: within-family pairs vs outside-family same-buyer window sample
computation_method: TF-IDF cosine similarity and CPV agreement over within-family pairs compared with a bounded outside-family same-buyer sample
caveat: Outside-family comparator is a bounded same-buyer/date-window sample, not a global non-match population; it is intended as a plausibility contrast for family grouping.

parameter_name: Marginal rate of each of the 5 quality flags
computation_method: mean of 0/1 flags (NaN-skipping)
caveat: award_link_unresolved is defined (non-NaN) only for APPEL_OFFRE notices; its rate is over that subset, not the full corpus. name_fallback was dropped as a deterministic subset of siret_or_siren_missing; see calib_buyer_name_variation_summary.csv (§7) instead.

parameter_name: Phi-coefficient correlation among 5 quality flags
computation_method: Pearson correlation on 0/1 flags (= phi coefficient), pairwise-complete
caveat: name_fallback excluded: it was a deterministic subset of siret_or_siren_missing (construction artifact, not an empirical association); award_link_unresolved correlations are computed pairwise over its APPEL_OFFRE-only non-NaN population.

parameter_name: Quality metrics split by digital-scope / PDL-scope eligibility
computation_method: groupby, mean of quality flags
caveat: is_digital_scope combines a CPV-division rule with a French keyword search over objet_normalized (config/pipeline.yaml scope block); it is a scope-tagging heuristic.

parameter_name: Future-only candidate counts per source notice
stratification: by environment x horizon x source strata
computation_method: strict future search (t_j > t_i), grouped searchsorted counts, production exports for capped pools
caveat: Ambient and BOAMP-native buyer-compatible rows are observable corpus-density measures; production rows are included only as capped-pool diagnostics and must not be used as ground truth links.

parameter_name: Candidate count quantiles under future-only environments
stratification: overall + identity source + buyer activity + schema + year + CPV + duration + digital segment
computation_method: groupby environment/horizon/strata, median/p75/p90/p95/p99/max and zero-candidate rates; candidate_notice_family_count is exact for materialized production pairs
caveat: The synthetic generator should reproduce conditional candidate difficulty; production-layer summaries in the same table remain diagnostics because they inherit pipeline blocking and caps. Notice-family counts are exact for production pairs and left missing for broad future environments to avoid materializing all ambient pairs.

parameter_name: Candidate count removed by each production filter
stratification: Layer 1 production sources; 60m ambient baseline to capped production pool
computation_method: stagewise counts after relevant notice type, digital scope, CPV scoring-only note, buyer blocking, expected-end temporal rule, and cap
caveat: The current pipeline has no hard CPV filter; CPV enters scoring, so the CPV stage intentionally removes zero candidates and documents that design choice.

parameter_name: Per-source follow-up time and 12/24/36/60-month evaluability flags (Work Package 9)
computation_method: F_i = (study_end_date - publication_date_i) in months; study_end_date = max(publication_date) over the full corpus, matching build_source_population (src/boamp/data/prepare.py)
caveat: Covers all APPEL_OFFRE sources regardless of digital scope (scope is a conditioning dimension, not a pre-filter, per §12); F_i is administrative follow-up only, independent of whether the pipeline actually linked the source to a later notice.

parameter_name: 12-month, 24-month, and full-survival-cohort populations, by year/segment/buyer-activity/schema/identifier-source
stratification: by cohort x stratum_dim x stratum_value
computation_method: evaluable_share = n_evaluable / n_total within each stratum; admin_censoring_rate = 1 - evaluable_share
caveat: full_survival_cohort has no fixed horizon by construction (every source belongs, right-censored at study end if unlinked), so its own admin_censoring_rate is trivially 0 everywhere; it is included as a population definition, not as a horizon-based exclusion like the 12/24-month cohorts.

parameter_name: true recurrence prevalence
value_or_range: e.g. sweep true recurrence prevalence in {10%, 25%, 40%, 60%}
computation_method: analyst judgment / literature-free
caveat: No verified legal-renewal field exists in BOAMP; the pipeline's own event rate (29.7%/35.1%) is itself the output of an unvalidated scoring+threshold procedure, not a measurement of real renewal behaviour.

parameter_name: true linkage precision recall
value_or_range: sweep precision/recall of the *injected* synthetic linker across a grid, e.g. precision in {0.6,0.75,0.9}, recall in {0.5,0.7,0.9}
computation_method: analyst judgment / literature-free
caveat: Zero completed manual-validation labels exist; Fellegi-Sunter EM estimates in 03_analysis are explicitly model-based, not ground-truth-validated.

parameter_name: true buyer entity resolution rate
value_or_range: sweep the fraction of buyer-name variants correctly resolved to one entity, e.g. {50%, 70%, 90%}
computation_method: analyst judgment / literature-free
caveat: No registry cross-validation of BOAMP-native buyer identity exists in this repo; the Layer 2 external SIREN join covers only 2024-2026 and the alias bridge is an unvalidated heuristic.

parameter_name: true candidate ambiguity resolution
value_or_range: vary the number of plausible-but-wrong candidates per true link, e.g. {0, 1-2, 3-5, 6+}, informed by §13's future-only candidate-density numbers
computation_method: analyst judgment / literature-free
caveat: Which candidate among several plausible same-buyer notices is the *correct* renewal is never verified; §15's rank-1 selection is a modelling choice, not ground truth.

parameter_name: true text corruption process
value_or_range: sweep text-similarity degradation severity for true-pair synthetic text, e.g. cosine similarity target ranges {0.3-0.5, 0.5-0.7, 0.7-0.9}
computation_method: analyst judgment / literature-free
caveat: No ground truth exists for how procurement text varies between a true renewal pair vs. an unrelated notice; §10's exact-duplicate rate only measures literal repetition.

parameter_name: Data-quality-defect co-occurrence among accepted links
computation_method: groupby variant+confidence_tier, mean of flags
caveat: Conditional on the pipeline's own threshold-based acceptance; selection bias by construction; must not be used as an unconditional error rate or to estimate true linkage accuracy.

parameter_name: Candidate-set size/margin at rank-1, by identifier/CPV quality
computation_method: groupby median
caveat: Reflects the pipeline's own 6-month window and 30-candidate cap (config/pipeline.yaml); compare against Section 13's future-only environment rebuild, do not treat as the 'true' candidate density.

parameter_name: Text-similarity distributions across 8 structural pair groups (Work Package 6)
computation_method: word TF-IDF cosine (reuses §10b fit), character 3-5gram TF-IDF cosine, token Jaccard, key-technical-term overlap, over bounded block-sampled pairs per group (capped per block and per group)
caveat: Groups 2-7 are structural comparison groups built from block sampling (buyer/CPV/name co-occurrence), not verified recurrence truth; only group 1 (same provisional notice family, §10b) is a relatively strong observable relationship. Sentence embeddings were not computed (rejected earlier for CPU-only runtime, docs/methodology.md §5); lexical measures are used instead.

parameter_name: Text similarity among the pipeline's own rank-1 candidate pairs
computation_method: pipeline's own fitted TF-IDF s_text plus this section's independent char-ngram/token-Jaccard/key-term measures, joined on source/candidate notice id
caveat: Sourced from the pre-threshold candidate pool (not accepted links), so this is a structural comparison group only — it shows what the pipeline's own blocking+scoring considers 'nearest', not a validated true-match population; never used to set synthetic ground truth (see §15).

parameter_name: Exact-duplicate objet_normalized group sizes and buyer/CPV composition
computation_method: groupby exact-string objet_normalized, non-missing text only
caveat: Exact-string literal duplication only (lower bound on template reuse, same limitation as §10's exact_duplicate_text_rate); distinct from §10b provisional notice families, which additionally require same buyer_key, date proximity, and CPV compatibility.

parameter_name: Same-buyer, same-CPV-division, high-text-similarity pairs with distinct detailed CPV
computation_method: dedicated same-buyer/same-cpv_division/different-cpv_clean pool (distinct from the same_buyer_different_cpv pair_group, which requires differing cpv_division), filtered to word_tfidf_cosine >= the different_buyer_different_cpv baseline's own p90 (0.031), top 500 by similarity
caveat: A necessary stress case for the synthetic benchmark (an easy benchmark without these would overstate linker performance); the similarity threshold is anchored to this notebook's own baseline distribution, not an externally validated cutoff.

parameter_name: Marginal rates and phi-correlation among 7 quality flags (Work Package 8)
computation_method: mean of 0/1 flags; Pearson/phi correlation, pairwise-complete
caveat: cpv_missing and cpv_generic are mutually exclusive states of the same field (cpv_generic_flag is False, not NaN, whenever CPV is absent), so their negative correlation is partly mechanical, not purely empirical; award_link_unresolved is APPEL_OFFRE-only (NaN elsewhere), matching §11's population restriction; name_fallback is excluded here (empirically identical to identifier_missing in this corpus, correlation exactly 1.0 - buyer_key_type takes only RAW_SIRET/NAME_FALLBACK values here, no RAW_SIREN rows observed) and kept only as an auxiliary flag for its one named joint pattern (next section).

parameter_name: Conditional missingness rates by schema/notice-type/year/CPV/buyer-activity/department
stratification: by stratum_dim x stratum_value (and schema x notice_type jointly)
computation_method: groupby each dimension (and the schema x notice_type pair), mean of each flag
caveat: Marginal-by-dimension tables condition on one variable at a time; only the schema x notice_type table is a genuine 2-way conditional view, which is what the §11 'Reasoning' example (legacy/eForms CPV-vs-duration trade-off) actually requires.

parameter_name: Per-flag L2-penalized logistic regression (odds ratios) with one schema x notice_type interaction
computation_method: sklearn LogisticRegression (default L2, C=1.0) per flag on one-hot main effects + a schema x notice_type interaction + standardized text_length/publication_year; train-set AUC reported as a diagnostic only
caveat: Coefficients are L2-regularized point estimates, not inferential p-values (no statsmodels dependency was introduced); AUC is computed on the training population, not held out, so it is a fit-quality diagnostic, not a generalization estimate.

parameter_name: Five named co-occurring quality-issue patterns (rate, expected-under-independence, lift)
computation_method: for each named pair of flags: joint rate over the pairwise-complete population, divided by the product of marginal rates (lift); one of the five patterns (name_fallback + large_candidate_pool) additionally draws on the Layer 1 candidate pool (see next provenance row)
caveat: unresolved_award_and_missing_contractor uses ATTRIBUTION-only fields (titulaire/annonce_lie) and is a different 'unresolved award' direction than §11's award_link_unresolved (which is about APPEL_OFFRE notices never receiving a resolved start date); the two must not be conflated.

parameter_name: name_fallback + large_candidate_pool joint-pattern rate
computation_method: large_candidate_pool = n_candidates_for_source >= its own p75 among rank-1 rows, joined back onto common by notice_id
caveat: Sourced from the pre-threshold candidate pool (not accepted links), restricted to sources that reached candidate generation; a structural comparison only, never used to set synthetic ground truth (see §15).

parameter_name: Top co-occurring quality-flag combinations and per-notice issue-count distribution
computation_method: groupby the 7 always-defined flags (excludes award_link_unresolved, APPEL_OFFRE-only), size per combination; row-wise sum of the same 7 flags for the issue count
caveat: Restricted to the 7 flags defined on the full corpus so every notice contributes exactly one combination; award_link_unresolved is excluded from the combination signature for the same reason it is population-restricted elsewhere in this notebook.

parameter_name: Blinded human-review queue sampled from 8 strata (Work Package 11)
computation_method: stratified sampling (up to 8 cases per stratum) from real Layer 1/Layer 2 pipeline outputs and §15b's hard-negative sample; every reviewer-facing field (reviewer, decision, confidence, evidence, disagreement, final_adjudication) is emitted null
caveat: This section produces zero labels - it only builds the queue a human still has to review. Scores/confidence tier/layer are held out of the blinded file and kept only in the technical join table, to avoid anchoring the reviewer on the pipeline's own decision (same practice as reports/final_single_reviewer_audit_guide.md).
